create.name: Divine Life Society of South Africa
create.bio:
The Divine Life Society of South Africa traces its start to 1949, when Swami Sivananda of Rishikesh sent his disciple Swami Sahajananda back to Durban to carry on his work there. Its headquarters is the Sivanandashram on Mountbatten Drive in Reservoir Hills, Durban, and its largest site is the Sivananda International Cultural Centre at La Mercy on the North Coast, a campus of halls, shrines and dining rooms on almost twenty hectares whose main prayer hall seats around 1,800 people. Further ashrams and satsang groups run across KwaZulu-Natal, Gauteng and the Western Cape, including a newer ashram in Sandton.

Its spiritual life centres on satsang, chanting and the practices Sivananda taught: japa, pranayama, asana and remembrance of God through the day. A one-day yoga camp held each month at La Mercy draws several hundred people, from small children to the elderly, who keep a daily spiritual diary between camps. The society keeps the great festivals, from Guru Purnima to Sivananda's birthday, publishes the Divine Life magazine, and streams its larger gatherings on YouTube. Alongside this it runs a wide programme of service, including schools and creches, skills centres and housing.

courses.title: Monthly Yoga Camp at La Mercy
courses.description: A Sunday-morning camp each month at the Sivananda International Cultural Centre, from 6 am to about noon, with lessons for age groups from pre-school to adults on Sivananda's teachings and daily practice of japa, pranayama and asana, kept up between camps with a spiritual diary.

courses.title: Ashrams and satsang groups
courses.description: The society's ashrams in Durban, Chatsworth, Pietermaritzburg, Stanger, Richards Bay and Sandton, the La Mercy centre and a Lenasia yoga centre, with local satsang groups across South Africa and contacts for each.

free_resources.title: Divine Life Magazine archive
free_resources.description: Back issues of the society's own magazine, free to read online, with teachings of Swami Sivananda and news of the South African ashrams.

free_resources.title: Sunlit Path Diary
free_resources.description: A printable spiritual diary for recording daily practice, in the form the society uses with young people at its yoga camps.
